asr.full_text: Your Bitcoin bonuses in the mirror trading international back office. In mirror trading international there are three streams of income. Firstly the bonus is you receive from daily trading No trading knowledge is required. You join the trading pool with a minimum of $100 of Bitcoin. Your Bitcoin is traded for you for Monday to Friday. Let's look at your back office dashboard. When you look at the Trading Pool Balance, remember the idea of Mirror Trading International is to grow your Bitcoin daily, but you will be compounding daily, meaning that the percentage you earn will be from the new balance at the end of the day and not your original balance. The US Dollar value is just an indication and will fluctuate with the bitcoin price. In your back office trading bonuses this will show you the bitcoin you have earned since you joined the trading pool. To view your daily trading results, you can simply click view detailed reports or go to the menu on the left, click on the my bonus report and then trading bonus report. On this page you will see the results from the daily trades and what you have earned. You can also click on the view button on the right of the actual data to view your statement. The values on statements are expressed in Bits. Please note that 1 bits equals 0.0000001 BTC. To get the Bitcoin value, divide your balance by 1 million. Don't be confused by the $US value. Check to make sure your bitcoin is in grain from day to day. The next stream of income from Mirotit Trading International is the referral bonus. If you refer other people you will get a ten percent direct referral bonus. Looking at the back office you will see your income wallet balance. This is the current available bonuses which includes the pending bonuses. Click on the includes pending bonuses to see a detailed report of all the referral bonuses that you have waiting and the time they will be released into your Income wallet. When these are released into your wallet you can either withdraw or reinvest into your trading pool. You decide either way, but try to get your bitcoin to work for you, whatever you choose to do. To see what is currently available for transfer or withdrawal from your income wallet, go to Internal Fund Transfer and this will show you your Income Wallet balance, Available Income Wallet balance, Pending Income Wallet balance, and your Pool Account balance. The third stream of income is the Binary Profit Sharing Bonus. You will need to be binary qualified to earn this bonus. This means you have personally introduced one person on the left and one person on the right of your business. You will also need to have at least $200 in your own position! This will qualify you for the binary bonus and you will receive a weekly binary bonus for your smallest leg. The day you sign up your second person according to the above criteria is the day you will start to benefit from the binary bonuses. Looking at your dashboard in the back office you will see the binary bonuses earned to date, and you are also able to click on the see detailed report to give you more information. which will show you the value of your weakest leg and your Binary Bonus for that week. This bonus will be released into your income wallet. The waiting period for the Binary Bonuses, just like the referral commissions, is 7 days. Finally, looking at All Time Total Bonuses, this will show you the total of everything that has come to your income wallet to date. In other words, the Bonuses, Referral Bonuses and the Binary Bonuses? For more information please speak to your Team Leader.

textual.observation: The speaker states that joining a trading pool with a minimum Bitcoin amount results in Bitcoin being traded on the participant's behalf, while describing daily growth and compounding.

evidence.quote: You join the trading pool with a minimum of $100 of Bitcoin. Your Bitcoin is traded for you for Monday to Friday.
remember the idea of Mirror Trading International is to grow your Bitcoin daily, but you will be compounding daily

textual.context: The claims are presented as an overview of the named platform's back office and trading pool; the source does not independently verify trading activity or returns.
textual.potential_relevance: A claimed daily Bitcoin-growth outcome is connected to contributing a stated minimum of $100 of Bitcoin to a pool that is said to trade participants' Bitcoin for them.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether funds are actually transferred, the actual performance of any trading, whether returns are guaranteed, or what withdrawal terms apply.

textual.observation: The speaker describes a ten percent bonus for referring other people, with bonuses later released to an income wallet that can be withdrawn or reinvested.

evidence.quote: The next stream of income from Mirotit Trading International is the referral bonus. If you refer other people you will get a ten percent
When these are released into your wallet you can either withdraw or reinvest into your trading pool.

textual.context: This is presented instructionally as a platform income stream. The ASR splits the percentage statement across records, and the source does not state what referred people must do for the bonus to be earned.
textual.potential_relevance: A stated ten percent referral bonus is linked to recruiting other people, and the resulting stated bonuses are described as becoming withdrawable or reinvestable wallet funds.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish the calculation basis for the ten percent, whether referral bonuses are paid in practice, or any actual withdrawal outcome.

textual.observation: The speaker says a weekly binary bonus requires personally introducing one person on each side and maintaining at least $200 in one's own position.

evidence.quote: This means you have personally introduced one person on the left and one person on the right of your business. You will also need to have at least $200 in your own position! This will qualify you for the binary bonus and you will receive a weekly binary bonus for your smallest leg.
This bonus will be released into your income wallet. The waiting period for the Binary Bonuses, just like the referral commissions, is 7 days.

textual.context: The speaker presents the binary arrangement as a stated qualification process and identifies a seven-day waiting period; no external verification is supplied.
textual.potential_relevance: A claimed weekly bonus is expressly conditioned on recruiting two people into designated positions and holding at least $200 in one's own position, with the source describing release to an income wallet after a waiting period.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish what the $200 position entails, the value or formula of the bonus, whether participants receive funds, or whether recruitment is compensated as described.

visual.limitations: The frames do not show enrollment, funding, withdrawal, actual trading activity, terms, or whether any displayed balance or bonus was received.

visual.observation: Slides label "Referral Bonuses" and show a dashboard instruction to click "Includes Pending" to view referral bonuses expected within the next 7 days.

visual.limitations: The samples do not show what referral action produces the bonus, its amount or conditions, or whether clicking the interface control causes any payment or transfer.

visual.observation: A slide states that becoming "binary qualified" requires personally introducing one person on the left and one on the right and having at least $200 in each position; it says this qualifies the participant for a weekly binary bonus on the smaller leg.
visual.context: Branded explanatory/presentation context describing a compensation qualification structure.
visual.potential_relevance: The stated weekly bonus is conditioned on recruiting people into two positions and maintaining a specified dollar amount in each position.
visual.limitations: The frame does not establish how funds are supplied, whether the positions represent actual participants or payments, the bonus amount, or any resulting payment.

visual.context: A branded interface demonstration or screenshot; no completed transfer is shown.

visual.limitations: The samples do not show a user entering an amount, confirming a transfer, the destination's operation, or any transaction outcome.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it presents its own branded Bitcoin trading program as offering daily compounded growth after joining a trading pool with at least $100 of Bitcoin. It promotes a 10 percent referral bonus and a weekly binary bonus tied to introducing people into two positions and maintaining at least $200, with bonuses shown as withdrawable or reinvestable wallet funds. The dashboard and slides show related BTC wallet-transfer and pending-bonus workflows, although the available video evidence does not establish that any transfer, trading activity, or payout was completed.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central offer is participation in a Bitcoin trading pool linked to passive daily trading earnings and compounding returns, which fits investment-pool returns. A separate binary qualification structure also links introducing people on two sides to weekly bonuses, supporting S06 as a secondary mechanism.
